o theyophilaa, yesu thaanu erparachukonina aposthalulaku parishuddhaatmadvaaraa, aagnaapinchina
tharuvaatha aayana paramunaku cherchukonabadina dinamuvaraku aayana cheyutakunu bodhinchutakunu aarambhinchina vaatinannitini goorchi naa modati granthamunu rachinchithini.

aayana shramapadina tharuvaatha naluvadhi dinamulavaraku vaari kagapaduchu, dhevuni raajyavishayamulanugoorchi bodhinchuchu, aneka pramaanamulanu choopi vaariki thannuthaanu sajeevunigaa kanuparachukonenu.
aayana vaarini kalisikoni yeelaagu aagnaapinchenu meeru yerooshalemunundi vellaka, naavalana vinina thandriyokka vaagdaanamukoraku kanipettudi;
yohaanu neellathoo baapthismamu icchenu gaani koddi dina mulalogaa meeru parishuddhaatmalo baapthismamu pondeda ranenu.
kaabatti vaaru koodivachinappudu prabhuvaa, yee kaalamandu ishraayelunaku raajyamunu marala anu grahinchedavaa? Ani aayananu adugagaa aayana
kaalamulanu samayamulanu thandri thana svaadheenamandunchukoni yunnaadu; vaatini telisikonuta mee panikaadu.

ayinanu parishuddhaatma mee meediki vachunappudu meeru shakthinondedaru ganuka meeru yerooshalemulonu, yoodaya samaraya dheshamula yandanthatanu bhoodiganthamula varakunu naaku saakshulai yundurani vaaritho cheppenu
ee maatalu cheppi, vaaru choochuchundagaa aayana aarohanamaayenu, appudu vaari kannulaku kanabadakunda oka meghamu aayananu konipoyenu.
aayana velluchundagaa, vaaru aakaashamuvaipu theri choochu chundiri. Idigo tellani vastramulu dharinchukonina yiddaru manushyulu vaariyoddha nilichi

galilaya manushyulaaraa, meerenduku nilichi aakaashamuvaipu choochu chunnaaru? meeyoddhanundi paralokamunaku cherchukona badina yee yese,e reethigaa paralokamunaku velluta meeru chuchithiro aa reethigaane aayana thirigi vachunani vaarithoo cheppiri.
appudu vaaru oleevala vanamanabadina kondanundi yerooshalemunaku thirigi velliri. aa konda yerooshalemunaku vishraanthidinamuna nadavadaginantha sameepamuna unnadhi,

vaaru pattanamulo praveshinchi thaamu basa cheyuchundina medagadhiloniki ekkipoyiri. Vaarevaranagaa pethuru, yohaanu, yaakobu, andreya, philippu, thoomaa, bartolomayi, matthayi, alphayi kumaarudagu yaakobu, jelothe anabadina seemonu, yaakobu kumaarudagu yoodhaa anu vaaru.
veeranda runu, veerithookooda kondaru streelunu, yesu thalliyaina mariyayu aayana sahodarulunu ekamanassuthoo eda tegaka praarthana cheyuchundiri.
aa kaalamandu inchuminchu noota iruvadhimandi sahodarulu koodiyundagaa pethuru vaari madhya nilichi itlanenu
sahodarulaaraa, yesunu pattukonina vaariki trova choopina yoodhaanugoorchi parishuddhaatma daaveedudvaaraa poorvamu palikina lekhanamu neraveravalasi yundenu.
athadu manalo okadugaa enchabadinavaadai yee paricharyalo paalupondhenu.
ee yoodhaa drohamuvalana sampaadhinchina rookala nichi yoka polamu konenu. Athadu thalakrindugaapadi nadimiki baddalainanduna athani pegulanniyu bayatiki vacchenu.
ee sangathi yerooshalemulo kaapuramunna vaarikandariki teliya vacchenu ganuka vaari bhaashalo aa polamu akeldama anabadiyunnadhi; daaniki rakthabhoomi ani arthamu. Induku pramaanamugaa
athani yillu paadaipovunugaaka daanilo evadunu kaapuramundaka povunugaaka athani yudyogamu verokadu theesikonunugaaka ani keerthanala granthamulo vraayabadiyunnadhi.
kaabatti yohaanu baapthismamichinadhi modalukoni prabhuvaina yesu manayoddhanundi paramunaku cherchukonabadina dinamu varaku,
aayana mana madhya sancharinchuchundina kaalamanthayu manathoo kalisiyunna veerilo okadu, manathoo kooda aayana punarut'thaanamunugoorchi saakshiyai yunduta aavashyakamani cheppenu.
appudu vaaru yoosthu anu maaruperugala barsabbaa anabadina yosepu, mattheeya anu iddarini niluvabetti
itlani praarthanachesiri andari hrudayamulanu erigiyunna prabhuvaa,
thana chootiki povutaku yoodhaa thappipoyi pogottukonina yee paricharyalonu aposthalatvamulonu paalupondutaku veeriddarilo neevu erparachukoninavaanini kanabarachumaniri.
anthata vaaru veerinigoorchi chitluveyagaa mattheeya perata chiti vacchenu ganuka athadu padunokandumandi aposthalulathoo kooda lekkimpabadenu.
pentekosthanu pandugadhinamu vachinappudu andaru okachoota koodiyundiri.
appudu vegamugaa veechu balamaina gaalivanti yokadhvani aakaashamunundi akasmaatthugaa, vaaru koorchundiyunna yillanthayu nindenu.
mariyu agnijvaalalavanti naalukalu vibhaagimpabadinattugaa vaariki kanabadi, vaarilo okkokkani meeda vraalaga
andaru parishuddhaatmathoo nindinavaarai aa aatma vaariki vaak‌shakthi anugrahinchinakoladhi anyabhaashalathoo maatalaadasaagiri.
aa kaalamuna aakaashamu krindanundu prathi janamulo nundi vachina bhakthigala yoodulu yerooshalemulo kaapuramundiri.
ee shabdamu kalugagaa janulu gumpulugaa koodivachi, prathi manushyudu thana thana svabhaashathoo vaaru maatalaaduta vini kalavarapadiri.
anthata andaru vibhraanthinondi aashcharyapadi idigo maatalaaduchunna veerandaru galilayulu kaaraa?
manalo prathivaadu thaanu puttina dheshapubhaashathoo veeru maatalaaduta manamu vinuchunnaame; idhemi?
paartheeyulu maadeeyulu elaameeyulu, mesopothamiya yoodaya kappadokiya, ponthu aasiya phrugiya pampuliya aigupthu anu dheshamulayandali vaaru,
kurenedaggara libiya praanthamulayandu kaapuramunnavaaru, romaanundi paravaasulugaa vachinavaaru, yoodulu, yoodamatha pravishtulu,
kretheeyulu arabeeyulu modalaina mana mandharamunu, veeru mana bhaashalathoo dhevuni goppakaaryamulanu vivarinchuta vinuchunnaamani cheppukoniri.
andaru vibhraanthinondi yetuthoochaka yidhemaguno ani okanithoo okadu cheppukoniri.
kondharaithe veeru krottha madyamuthoo nindiyunnaarani apahaasyamu chesiri.

ayithe pethuru aa padunokarithookooda lechi nilichi biggaragaa vaarithoo itlanenu.Yoodaya manushyulaaraa, yerooshalemulo kaapuramunna samastha janulaaraa, yidi meeku teliyugaaka, cheviyoggi naa maatalu vinudi.
meeru oohinchunattu veeru matthulu kaaru, proddubodichi jaamayina kaaledu.
yovelu pravaktha dvaaraa cheppabadina sangathi yidhe, emanagaa
antya dinamulayandu nenu manushyulandari meeda naa aatmanu kummarinchedanu mee kumaarulunu mee kumaarthelunu pravachinchedaru mee ¸yauvanulaku darshanamulu kalugunu mee vruddhulu kalalu kanduru.
aa dinamulalo naa daasulameedanu naa daasuraandra meedanu naa aatmanu kummarinchedanu ganuka vaaru pravachinchedaru.
paina aakaashamandu mahatkaaryamulanu krinda bhoomimeeda soochakakriyalanu rakthamunu agnini poga aavirini kalugajesedanu.
prabhuvu pratyakshamagu aa mahaadhinamu raakamunupu sooryudu chikatigaanu chandrudu rakthamugaanu maaruduru.
appudu prabhuvu naamamunubatti praarthanacheyu vaarandarunu rakshanaponduduru ani dhevudu cheppuchunnaadu.

ishraayeluvaaralaaraa, yee maatalu vinudi. dhevudu najareyudagu yesuchetha adbhuthamulanu mahatkaaryamulanu soochakakriyalanu mee madhyanu cheyinchi, aayananu thanavalana meppupondina vaanigaa meeku kanabarachenu; idi meere yeruguduru.
dhevudu nishchayinchina sankalpamunu aayana bhavishyad‌ gnaanamunu anusarinchi appagimpabadina yeeyananu meeru dushtulachetha siluva veyinchi champithiri.
maranamu aayananu bandhinchi yunchuta asaadhyamu ganuka dhevudu maranavedhanalu tolaginchi aayananu lepenu.
aayananu goorchi daaveedu itlanenu-nenellappudu naa yeduta prabhuvunu choochuchuntini aayana naa kudipaarshvamuna nunnaadu ganuka nenu kadalchabadanu.
kaavuna naa hrudayamu ullasinchenu; naa naaluka aanandinchenu mariyu naa shareeramu kooda nireekshana galigi nilakadagaa undunu.
neevu naa aatmanu paathaalamulo vidichipettavu nee parishuddhuni kullupattaniyyavu.
naaku jeevamaargamulu telipithivi nee darshana manugrahinchi nannu ullaasamuthoo nimpedavu
sahodarulaaraa, moolapurushudagu daaveedunugoorchi meethoo nenu dhaaraalamuga maatalaadavachunu. Athadu chanipoyi samaadhicheyabadenu;

athani samaadhi netivaraku mana madhya nunnadhi. Athadu pravakthayai yundenu ganuka athani garbhaphalamulonundi athani sinhaasanamumeeda okani koorchundabettudunu ani dhevudu thanathoo pramaanapoorvakamugaa ottu pettukonina sangathi athaderegi,
kreesthu paathaalamulo viduva badaledaniyu, aayana shareeramu kullipoledaniyu daaveedu mundhugaa telisikoni aayana punarut'thaanamunu goorchi cheppenu.
ee yesunu dhevudu lepenu; deeniki memandharamu saakshulamu.
kaagaa aayana dhevuni kudi paarshvamunaku hechimpabadi, parishuddhaatmanu goorchina vaagdaanamunu thandrivalana pondi, meeru choochuchu vinuchununna deenini kummarinchi yunnaadu.
daaveedu paralokamunaku ekki poledu; ayithe athaditlanenu–nenu nee shatruvulanu nee paadamulakrinda paadapeethamugaa unchuvaraku
neevu naa kudipaarshvamuna koorchundumani prabhuvu naa prabhuvuthoo cheppenu.
meeru siluvavesina yee yesune dhevudu prabhuvugaanu kreesthugaanu niyaminchenu. Idi ishraayelu vanshamanthayu roodhigaa telisikonavalenani cheppenu.
vaaru ee maata vini hrudayamulo nochukoni sahodarulaaraa, mememi chethumani pethurunu kadama aposthalulanu adugagaa
pethuru meeru maarumanassu pondi, paapakshamaapana nimitthamu prathivaadu yesukreesthu naamamuna baapthismamu pondudi; appudu meeru parishuddhaatma anu varamu ponduduru.
ee vaagdaanamu meekunu mee pillalakunu doorasthulandarikini, anagaa prabhuvaina mana dhevudu thanayoddhaku pilichina vaarikandarikini chendunani vaarithoo cheppenu.
inkanu aneka vidhamulaina maatalathoo saakshyamichi meeru moorkhulagu ee tharamuvaariki verai rakshanapondudani vaarini heccharinchenu.
kaabatti athani vaakyamu angeekarinchina vaaru baapthismamu pondiri, aa dinamandu inchuminchu mooduvela mandi cherchabadiri.
veeru aposthalula bodhayandunu sahavaasamandunu, rotte viruchutayandunu praarthana cheyutayandunu edategaka yundiri.
appudu prathivaanikini bhayamu kaligenu. Mariyu aneka mahatkaaryamulunu soochakakriyalunu aposthalula dvaaraa jarigenu.
vishvasinchinavaarandaru ekamugaa koodi thamaku kaliginadanthayu samashtigaa unchu koniri.
idiyugaaka vaaru thama charasthiraasthulanu ammi, andarikini vaari vaari akkarakoladhi panchipettiri.
mariyu vaarekamanaskulai prathidinamu dhevaalayamulo thappaka koodukonuchu intinta rotte viruchuchu, dhevuni sthuthinchuchu, prajalandarivalana dayapondinavaarai
aanandamuthoonu nishkapatamaina hrudayamuthoonu aahaaramu puchukonuchundiri. Mariyu prabhuvurakshana ponduchunnavaarini anudinamu vaarithoo cherchuchundenu.
pagalu moodu gantalaku praarthanakaalamuna pethurunu yohaanunu dhevaalayamunaku ekki velluchundagaa,

puttinadhi modalukoni kuntivaadaina yoka manushyudu mosikonipobaduchundenu. Vaadu dhevaalayamuloniki velluvaarini bhikshamadugutaku kondaru prathidinamu vaanini shrungaaramanu dhevaalayapu dvaaramunoddha unchuchu vachiri.
pethurunu yohaanunu dhevaalayamulo praveshimpa bovunappudu vaadu chuchi bhikshamadugagaa
pethurunu yohaanunu vaanini theri chuchimaathattu choodumaniri.
vaadu vaariyoddha emaina dorukunani kanipettuchu vaariyandu lakshyamunchenu.
anthata pethuruvendi bangaaramulu naayoddha levu gaani naaku kaliginadhe nee kichuchunnaanu; najareyudaina yesu kreesthu naamamuna naduvumani cheppi
vaani kudicheyyi pattukoni levanettenu; ventane vaani paadamulunu chilamandalunu balamu pondhenu.
vaadu digguna lechi nilichi nadichenu; naduchuchu ganthulu veyuchu dhevuni sthuthinchuchu vaarithookooda dhevaalayamuloniki vellenu.
vaadu naduchuchu dhevuni sthuthinchuta prajalandaru chuchi
shrungaaramanu dhevaalayapu dvaaramunoddha bhikshamukoraku koorchundinavaadu veede ani gurterigi,vaaniki jarigina daanini chuchi vismayamuthoo nindi paravashulairi.
vaadu pethurunu yohaanunu pattukoni yundagaa, prajalandaru vismayamondi solomonudanu mantapamulo unna vaariyoddhaku gumpugaa parugetthivachiri.

pethuru deenini chuchi prajalathoo itlanenu ishraayeleeyulaaraa, meeru veeni vishayamai yenduku aashcharyapaduchunnaaru? Maasonthashakthi chethanainanu bhakthichethanainanu nadavanu veeniki balamichi nattugaa meerenduku maathattu theri choochuchunnaaru?

abraahaamu issaaku yaakobu anuvaari dhevudu, anagaa mana pitharula dhevudu thana sevakudaina yesunu mahimaparachiyunnaadu; meeraayananu appaginchithiri, pilaathu aayananu vidudala cheyutaku nishchayinchinappudu meeru athaniyeduta aayananu niraakarinchithiri.
meeru parishuddhudunu neethimanthudunaina vaanini niraakarinchi, nara hanthakudaina manushyuni meeku anugrahimpumani adigithiri.
meeru jeevaadhipathini champithiri gaani dhevudu aayananu mruthulalonundi lepenu; anduku memu saakshulamu.
aayana naamamandali vishvaasamumoolamugaa aayana naamame meeru chuchi yerigiyunna veenini balaparachenu; aayanavalana kaligina vishvaasame mee andariyeduta veeniki ee poornasvasthatha kalugajesenu.
sahodarulaaraa, meerunu mee adhikaarulunu teliyaka chesithirani naaku teliyunu.
ayithe dhevudu thana kreesthu shramapadunani samastha pravakthalanota mundhugaa prachuraparachina vishaya mulanu eelaagu neraverchenu.
prabhuvu samukhamu nundi vishraanthikaalamulu vachunatlunu
meekoraku niyaminchina kreesthuyesunu aayana pampunatlunu mee paapamulu thudichiveyabadu nimitthamunu maarumanassu nondi thirugudi.
annitiki kudurubaatu kaalamulu vachunani dhevudu aadhinundi thana parishuddha pravakthalanota palikinchenu. Anthavaraku yesu paraloka nivaasiyai yunduta aavashyakamu.
moshe yitlanenuprabhuvaina dhevudu naavanti yoka pravakthanu mee sahodarulalo nundi meekoraku puttinchunu; aayana meethoo emi cheppinanu anni vishayamulalo meeraayana maata vinavalenu.
aa pravaktha maata vinanivaadu prajalalo undakunda sarvanaashanamagunanenu.
mariyu samooyelu modalukoni yendaru pravakthalu pravachinchiro vaarandaru ee dinamunugoorchi prakatinchiri.
aa pravakthalakunu, dhevudu abraahaamuthoo nee santhaanamandu bhooloka vanshamulanniyu aasheervadhimpabadunani cheppi mee pitharulathoo chesina nibandhanakunu, meeru vaarasulai yunnaaru.
dhevudu thana sevakuni puttinchi, meelo prathivaanini vaani dushtatvamunundi mallinchutavalana mimmu naasheervadhinchutaku aayananu modata meeyoddhaku pampenani cheppenu.
vaaru prajalathoo maatalaaduchundagaa, yaajakulunu dhevaalayapu adhipathiyu saddookayyulunu
vaaru prajalaku bodhinchutayu, yesunubatti mruthulalonundi punaru t'thaanamu kalugunani prakatinchutayu chuchi kalavarapadi vaarimeedikivachi
vaarini balaatkaaramugaa pattukoni, saayankaalamainanduna marunaativaraku vaarini kaavalilo unchiri.
vaakyamu vininavaarilo anekulu nammiri. Vaarilo purushula sankhya yinchuminchu ayiduvelu aayenu.
marunaadu vaari adhikaarulunu peddalunu shaastrulunu yerooshalemulo koodukoniri.
pradhaana yaajakudaina annayu kayapayu, yohaanunu aleksandrunu pradhaanayaajakuni bandhuvulandaru vaarithoo kooda undiri.
vaaru pethurunu yohaanunu madhyanu niluvabetti meeru e balamuchetha e naamamunubatti deenini chesithirani adugagaa
pethuru parishuddhaatmathoo nindinavaadai yitlanenu prajala adhikaarulaaraa, peddalaaraa,
aa durbaluniki cheyabadina upakaaramunugoorchi vaadu dhenivalana svasthatha pondenani nedu mammunu vimarshinchuchunnaaru ganuka

meerandarunu ishraayelu prajalandarunu telisikonavalasina dhemanagaa, meeru siluvavesinattiyu, mruthulalonundi dhevudu lepinattiyu najareyudaina yesukreesthu naamamunane veedu svasthathapondi mee yeduta niluchuchunnaadu.
illu kattuvaaraina meeru truneekarinchina raayi aayane; aa raayi moolaku thalaraayi aayenu.
mari evanivalananu rakshana kalugadu; ee naamamunane manamu rakshana pondavalenu gaani, aakaashamu krinda manushyulalo iyyabadina mari e naamamuna rakshana pondalemu anenu.
vaaru pethuru yohaanula dhairyamunu chuchinappudu vaaru vidyaleni paamarulani grahinchi aashcharyapadi, vaaru yesuthookooda undinavaarani gurterigiri.
svasthatha pondina aa manushyudu vaarithoo kooda nilichiyunduta chuchi yemiyu eduru cheppalekapoyiri.
appudu sabha velupaliki pondani vaari kaagnaapinchi thamalothaamu aalochana chesi
ee manushyulanu manamemi cheyudamu? Vaarichetha prasiddhamaina soochakakriya cheya badiyunnadani yerooshalemulo kaapuramunna vaarikandariki spashtame, adhi jarugaledani cheppajaalamu
ayinanu idi prajalalo inka vyaapimpakundutakai ikameedata ee naamamunubatti ye manushyulathoonainanu maatalaada koodadani manamu vaarini bedarupettavalenani cheppukoniri.
appudu vaarini pilipinchimeeru yesu naamamunubatti yenthamaatramunu maatalaadakoodadu, bodhimpanukoodadani vaarikaagnaapinchiri.
andukupethurunu yohaanunu vaarinichuchi dhevuni maata vinutakante mee maata vinuta dhevuni drushtiki nyaayamaa? meere cheppudi;
memu kannavaatini vinnavaatini cheppaka yundalemani vaariki uttharamichiri;
prajalandaru jarigina daaninigoorchi dhevuni mahimaparachuchundiri ganuka sabhavaaru prajalaku bhayapadi, veerini shikshinchu vidhamemiyu kanugona leka veerini gattigaa bedarinchi vidudalachesiri.
svastha parachuta anu aa soochakakriya yevani vishayamulo cheyabadeno vaadu naluvadhi endlakante ekkuva vayassu galavaadu.
vaaru vidudala nondi thama svajanulayoddhaku vachi, pradhaanayaajakulunu peddalunu thamathoo cheppina maatala nannitini vaariki telipiri.
vaaru vini, yeka manassuthoo dhevunikitlu biggaragaa moṟapettiri. Naathaa, neevu aakaashamunu bhoomini samudramunu vaatiloni samasthamunu kalugajesinavaadavu.
anyajanulu ela allari chesiri? Prajalenduku vyarthamaina aalochanalu pettukoniri?
prabhuvumeedanu aayana kreesthumeedanu bhooraajulu lechiri, adhikaarulunu ekamugaa koodukoniri ani neevu parishuddhaatmadvaaraa maa thandriyu nee sevakudunaina daaveedu nota palikinchithivi.
evi jarugavalenani nee hasthamunu nee sankalpamunu mundu nirnayincheno,

vaati nannitini cheyutakai neevu abhishekinchina nee parishuddha sevakudaina yesunaku virodhamugaa herodunu ponthi pilaathunu anyajanulathoonu ishraayelu prajalathoonu ee pattanamandu nijamugaa koodukoniri.
prabhuvaa, ee samayamunandu vaari bedarimpulu chuchi

rogulanu svasthaparachutakunu, nee parishuddha sevakudaina yesu naamamu dvaaraa soochaka kriyalanu mahatkaaryamulanu cheyu takunu nee cheyyi chaachiyundagaa, nee daasulu bahu dhairyamugaa nee vaakyamunu bodhinchunatlu anugra hinchumu.
vaaru praarthanacheyagaane vaaru koodi yunna chootu kampinchenu; appudu vaarandaru parishuddhaatmathoo nindinavaarai dhevuni vaakyamunu dhairyamugaa bodhinchiri.
vishvasinchinavaarandarunu ekahrudayamunu ekaatmayu galavaarai yundiri. Evadunu thanaku kaligina vaatilo ediyu thanadani anukonaledu; vaariki kaliginadanthayu vaariki samashtigaa undenu.
idiyugaaka aposthalulu bahu balamugaa prabhuvaina yesu punarut'thaanamunu goorchi saakshyamichiri. Daivakrupa andariyandu adhikamugaa undenu.
bhoomulainanu indlayinanu kaliginavaarandaru vaatini ammi, ammina vaati velatechi aposthalula paadamulayoddha pettuchu vachiri.
vaaru prathivaaniki vaanivaani akkarakoladhi panchipettiri ganuka vaarilo evanikini koduvalekapoyenu.
kupralo puttina leveeyudagu yosepu anu oka dundenu. Ithaniki aposthalulu, heccharika putrudu ani arthamichu barnabaa anu peru pettiyundiri. Ithadu bhoomigalavaadai yundi daanini ammi
daani velatechi aposthalula paadamulayoddha pettenu.
ananeeya anu oka manushyudu thana bhaaryayaina sappeeraathoo ekamai polamammenu.
bhaarya yerukane vaadu daani velalo kontha daachukoni kontha techi aposthalula paadamulayoddha pettenu.
appudu pethuru ananeeyaa, nee bhoomi velalo kontha daachukoni pari shuddhaatmanu mosapuchutaku saathaanu enduku nee hrudayamunu prerepinchenu.?

adhi neeyoddha nunnapudu needhe gadaa? Ammina pimmata adhi nee vashamai yundaledaa? Yenduku ee sangathi nee hrudayamulo uddheshinchu konnaavu? neevu manushyulathoo kaadu dhevunithoone abaddhamaadithivani vaanithoo cheppenu.
ananeeya yee maatalu vinuchune padi praanamu viduvagaa vininavaari kandarikini migula bhayamu kaligenu;
appudu paduchu vaaru lechi vaanini battathoo chutti mosikonipoyi paathipettiri.
inchuminchu moodu gantala sepatiki vaanibhaarya jariginadhi yerugaka lopaliki vacchenu.
appudu pethurumeeru aa bhoomini inthake ammithiraa naathoo cheppumani aamenu adigenu. Andukaame avunu inthake ani cheppenu.

anduku pethuru prabhuvuyokka aatmanu shodhinchutaku meerenduku ekeebhavinchithiri? Idigo nee penimitini paathipettinavaari paadamulu vaakitane yunnavi; vaaru ninnunu mosikoni povudurani aameto cheppenu.
ventane aame athani paadamulayoddha padi praanamu vidichenu. aa paduchuvaaru, lopaliki vachi, aame chanipoyinadhi chuchi, aamenu mosikonipoyi, aame penimitiyoddha paathipettiri.
sanghamanthatikini, ee sangathulu vininavaarikandarikini migula bhayamu kaligenu.
prajalamadhya anekamaina soochakakriyalunu maha tkaaryamulunu aposthalulachetha cheyabaduchundenu. Mariyu vaarandaru ekamanaskulai solomonu mantapa mulo undiri.
kadamavaarilo evadunu vaarithoo kalisi konutaku tegimpaledu gaani
prajalu vaarini ghanaparachu chundiri. Purushulunu streelunu anekulu mariyekkuvaga vishvaasulai prabhuvu pakshamuna cherchabadiri.
andu chetha pethuru vachuchundagaa janulu rogulanu veedhulaloniki techi, vaarilo evanimeedhanainanu athani needayainanu padavalenani manchamulameedanu parupulameedanu vaarini unchiri.
mariyu yerooshalemu chuttunundu pattanamula janulu rogulanu apavitraatmalachetha peedimpa badina vaarini mosikoni koodivachiri. Vaarandaru svasthatha pondiri.
pradhaanayaajakudunu athanithoo kooda unnavaarandarunu, anagaa saddookayyula tegavaaru lechi matsaramuthoo nindukoni
aposthalulanu balaatkaaramugaa pattukoni pattanapu cherasaalalo unchiri.
ayithe prabhuvu dootha raatrivela aa cherasaala thalupulu theesi vaarini velupaliki theesikoni vachimeeru velli dhevaalayamulo niluvabadi
ee jeevamunugoorchina maatalanniyu prajalathoo cheppudani vaarithoo anenu.

vaaraamaata vini, tellavaaragaane dhevaalayamuloniki velli bodhinchuchundiri. Pradhaana yaajakudunu athanithookooda nunna vaarunu vachi, mahaa sabhavaarini ishraayeleeyula peddalanandarini piluvanampinchivaarini thoodukoni randani bantrauthulanu cherasaalaku pampiri.
bantrauthulu akkadiki vellinappudu vaaru cherasaalalo kanabadananduna thirigivachi
cherasaala bahu bhadramugaa moosiyundutayu, kaavalivaaru thalupula mundhara nilichiyundutayu chuchithivi gaani thalupulu theesinappudu lopala maakokadainanu kanabadaledani vaariki telipiri.
anthata dhevaalayapu adhipathiyu pradhaana yaajakulunu aa maatalu vini'idi yemavuno ani vaari vishayamai yetuthoochaka yundiri.
appudu okadu vachi'idigo meeru cherasaalalo veyinchina manushyulu dhevaalayamulo nilichi prajalaku bodhinchuchunnaarani vaariki telupagaa
adhipathi bantrauthulathoo kooda poyi, prajalu raallathoo kottuduremo ani bhayapadi, balaatkaaramu cheyakaye vaarini theesikoni vacchenu.
vaarini theesikoni vachi sabhalo niluvabettagaa

pradhaanayaajakudu vaarini chuchimeeru ee naamamunubatti bodhimpakoodaddani memu meeku khandithamugaa aagnaapimpaledaa? Idigo meeru yerooshalemunu mee bodhathoo nimpi, yee manushyuni hatya maameediki thevalenani uddheshinchuchunnaarani cheppenu.
anduku pethurunu aposthalulunumanushyalaku kaadu dhevunike memu lobadavalenu gadaa.
meeru mraanuna vrelaadavesi sanharinchina yesunu mana pitharula dhevudu lepenu.
ishraayelunaku maarumanassunu paapa kshamaapananu dayacheyutakai dhevudaayananu adhipathini gaanu rakshakunigaanu thana dakshinahasthabalamuchetha hechinchi yunnaadu.
memunu, dhevudu thanaku vidheyulaina vaariki anugrahinchina parishuddhaatmayu, ee sangathulaku saakshulamai yunnaamani cheppiri.
vaaru ee maata vini atyaagrahamu techukoni veerini champa nuddheshinchagaa

samastha prajalavalana ghanatha nondinavaadunu dharmashaastropadheshakudunaina gamaleeyelanu oka parisayyudu mahaasabhalo lechi'ee manushyulanu kontha sepu velupala unchudani aagnaapinchi vaarithoo itlanenu
ishraayeleeyulaaraa, yee manushyula vishayamai meeremi cheyabovuchunnaaro jaagratthasumandi.

ee dinamulaku munupu thoodaa lechi thaanoka goppa vaadanani cheppukonenu; inchuminchu nannoorumandi manushyulu vaanithoo kalisi koniri, vaadu champabadenu, vaaniki lobadina vaarandarunu chedari vyarthulairi.

vaaniki tharuvaatha janasankhya dinamulalo galilayudaina yoodhaa anu okadu vachi, prajalanu thanathoo kooda thirugubaatucheya prerepinchenu; vaadukooda nashinchenu, vaaniki lobadinavaarandarunu chedari poyiri.
kaabatti nenu meethoo cheppunadhemanagaa ee manushyula joliki poka vaarini vidichipettudi. ee aalochanayainanu ee kaaryamainanu manushyulavalana kaligina daayenaa adhi vyarthamagunu.
dhevunivalana kaliginadaayenaa meeru vaarini vyarthaparachaleru; meerokavela dhevunithoo poraaduvaaravuduru sumee.
vaarathani maataku sammathinchi, aposthalulanu pilipinchi kottinchiyesu naamamunubatti bodhimpakoodadani aagnaapinchi vaarini vidudala chesiri.
aa naamamukoraku avamaanamu pondutaku paatrulani yenchabadinanduna vaaru santhooshinchuchu mahaasabha yedutanundi vellipoyi
prathidinamu dhevaalayamulonu intintanu maanaka bodhinchuchu, yese kreesthani prakatinchuchundiri.
aa dinamulalo shishyula sankhya vistharinchuchunnappudu anudina paricharyalo thamaloni vidhavaraandranu chinnachoopu chuchirani hebreeyulameeda greekubhaasha maatlaadu yoodulu sanugasaagiri.
appudu pandrenduguru aposthalulu thamayoddhaku shishyula samoohamunu pilichimemu dhevuni vaakyamu bodhinchuta maani, aahaaramu panchipettuta yukthamukaadu.
kaabatti sahodarulaaraa, aatmathoonu gnaanamuthoonu nindukoni manchiperu pondina yeduguru manushyulanu meelo erparachukonudi. Memu vaarini ee paniki niyaminthumu;
ayithe memu praarthanayandunu vaakyaparicharyayandunu edategaka yundumani cheppiri.

ee maata janasamoohamanthatiki ishtamainanduna vaaru, vishvaasamuthoonu parishuddhaatmathoonu nindukoninavaadaina stephanu, philippu, prokoru, neekaa noru, theemonu, parmenaasu, yoodula mathapravishtudunu anthiyokayavaadunu agu neekolaasu anu vaarini erparachukoni
vaarini aposthalulayeduta niluvabettiri; veeru praarthanachesi vaarimeeda chethulunchiri.
dhevuni vaakyamu prabalamai shishyula sankhya yeroosha lemulo bahugaa vistharinchenu; mariyu yaajakulalo anekulu vishvaasamunaku lobadiri.
stephanu krupathoonu balamuthoonu nindinavaadai prajala madhya mahatkaaryamulanu goppa soochaka kriyalanu cheyuchundenu.
appudu libertheenuladhanabadina samaajamu lonu, kureneeyula samaajamulonu, aleksandriyula samaajamulonu, kilikiyanundiyu aasiyanundiyu vachinavaarilonu, kondaru vachi stephanuthoo tharkinchiri gaani
maatalaadutayandu athadu agaparachina gnaanamunu athanini prerepinchina aatmanu vaaredirimpalekapoyiri.
appudu vaaruveedu moshemeedanu dhevunimeedanu dooshanavaakyamulu palukagaa memu vintimani chepputaku manushyulanu kudurchukoni
prajalanu peddalanu shaastrulanu repi athanimeediki vachi

athanini pattukoni mahaasabha yoddhaku theesikonipoyi abaddhapu saakshulanu niluvabettiri. Vaaru ee manushyudeppudunu ee parishuddha sthalamunakunu mana dharma shaastramunakunu virodhamugaa maatalaaduchunnaadu
ee najareyudaina yesu ee chootunu paaduchesi, moshe manakichina aachaaramulanu maarchunani veedu cheppagaa memu vintimaniri.
sabhalo koorchunna vaarandaru athanivaipu therichoodagaa athani mukhamu dhevadootha mukhamuvale vaariki kanabadenu.
pradhaanayaajakudu ee maatalu nijamenaa ani adigenu.

anduku stephanu cheppinadhemanagaa sahodarulaaraa, thandrulaaraa, vinudi. Mana pitharudaina abraahaamu haaraanulo kaapuramundaka munupu mesopothamiyalo unnappudu mahimagala dhevudu athaniki pratyakshamai
neevu nee dheshamunu nee svajanamunu vidichi bayaludheri, nenu neeku choopimpabovu dheshamunaku rammani athanithoo cheppenu.

appudathadu kaldeeyula dheshamunu vidichipoyi haaraanulo kaapuramundenu. Athani thandri chanipoyina tharuvaatha, akkada nundi meerippudu kaapuramunna yee dheshamandu nivasinchutakai dhevudathani theesikonivacchenu

aayana indulo athaniki paadamu pattunantha bhoominainanu svaasthyamugaa iyyaka, athaniki kumaarudu lenappudu athanikini, athani tharuvaatha athani santhaanamunakunu deenini svaadheenaparathunani athaniki vaagdaanamu chesenu.
ayithe dhevudu athani santhaanamu anyadheshamandu paravaasu laguduraniyu, aa dheshasthulu nannooru samvatsaramula mattuku vaarini daasyamunaku loparuchukoni baadha pettuduraniyu cheppenu
mariyu dhevudu e janamu naku vaaru daasulai yunduro aa janamunu nenu vimarsha cheyudunaniyu, aa tharuvaatha vaaru vachi ee chootanannu sevinthuraniyu cheppenu.

mariyu aayana sunnathi vishayamaina nibandhana athani kanugrahinchenu. Athadu issaakunu kani aa nibandhana choppuna enimidava dinamandu atha niki sunnathichesenu; issaaku yaakobunu yaakobu panniddaru gotrakarthalanu kani vaariki sunnathi chesiri.
aa gotrakarthalu matsarapadi, yosepunu aigupthuloniki povutaku ammivesirigaani, dhevudathaniki thoodaiyundi athani shramalannitilonundi thappinchi
dayanu gnaanamunu aigupthu raajaina pharoyeduta athaniki anu grahinchinanduna pharo aigupthunakunu thana yintikanthatikini athanini adhipathigaa niyaminchenu.
tharuvaatha aigupthu dheshamanthatikini kanaanu dheshamanthatikini karavunu bahu shramayuvacchenu ganuka mana pitharulaku aahaaramu lekapoyenu.
aigupthulo dhaanyamu kaladani yaakobu vini, mana pitharulanu akkadiki modati saari pampenu.
vaaru rendavasaari vachinappudu yosepu thana annadammulaku thannu teliyajesi konenu; appudu yosepu yokka vanshamu pharoku teliyavacchenu.
yosepu thana thandriyaina yaakobunu thana svajanulandarini piluvanampenu; vaaru debbadhiyayidu guru
yaakobu aigupthunaku vellenu; akkada athadunu mana pitharulunu chanipoyi akkada nundi shekemunaku thebadi,
shekemuloni hamoru kumaarulayoddha abraa haamu velayichikonina samaadhilo unchabadiri.

ayithe dhevudu abraahaamunaku anugrahinchina vaagdaana kaalamu sameepinchinakoladhi prajalu aigupthulo visthaaramugaa vruddhi pondiri. thudaku yosepunu erugani verokaraaju aigupthunu elanaarambhinchenu.
ithadu mana vanshasthula yedala kapatamugaa pravarthinchi
thama shishuvulu bradukakunda vaarini bayata paaraveyavalenani mana pitharulanu baadha pettenu.
aa kaalamandu moshe puttenu. Athadu divyasundarudai thana thandri yinta moodu nelalu pencha badenu.
tharuvaatha athadu bayata paaraveyabadinappudu pharo kumaarthe athanini theesikoni thana kumaarunigaa penchu konenu.
moshe aiguptheeyula sakala vidyalanu abhyasinchi, maatalayandunu kaaryamulayandunu praveenudai yundenu.
athaniki naluvadhi endlu nindavachinappudu ishraayeleeyulaina thana sahodarulanu choodavalenanna buddhi puttenu.
appudu vaarilo okadu anyaayamu nanubhavinchuta athadu chuchi, vaanini rakshinchi baadhapadinavaani pakshamuna aiguptheeyuni champi prathikaaramuchesenu.
thana dvaaraa thana sahodarulaku dhevudu rakshana dayacheyuchunna sangathi vaaru grahinthurani athadu thalanchenu gaani vaaru grahimparairi.
marunaadu iddaru potlaaduchundagaa athadu vaarini chuchi ayyalaaraa, meeru sahodarulu; meerenduku okanikokadu anyaayamu chesikonuchunnaarani cheppi vaarini samaadhaanaparacha joochenu.
ayinanu thana poruguvaaniki anyaayamu chesinavaadumaa meeda adhikaarinigaanu theerparinigaanu ninnu niyaminchina vaadevadu?
neevu ninna aiguptheeyuni champinattu nannunu champadalachiyunnaavaa ani athanini trosivesenu.
moshe aa maata vini paaripoyi midyaanu dheshamulo paradheshiyaiyundi, akkada iddaru kumaarulanu kanenu.
naluvadhi endlayina pimmata seenaayi parvathaaranyamandu oka podaloni agnijvaalalo oka dhevadootha athanikagapadenu.
moshe chuchi aa darshanamunaku aashcharyapadi daani nidaaninchi choochutaku daggaraku raagaa
nenu nee pitharula dhevudanu, abraahaamu issaaku yaakobula dhevudanu ani prabhuvu vaakku vinabadenu ganuka moshe vanaki, nidaaninchi choochutaku tegimpa ledu.
anduku prabhuvunee cheppulu viduvumu; neevu nilichiyunnachootu parishuddhabhoomi.

aigupthulo nunna naa prajala duravasthanu nenu nidaaninchi chuchithini; vaari moolugu vintini; vaarini vidipinchutaku digivachi yunnaanu; rammu, nenippudu ninnu aigupthunaku pampudunani athanithoo cheppenu.

adhikaarinigaanu theerparinigaanu ninnu niyaminchinavaadevadani vaaru niraakarinchina yee moshenu athaniki podalo kanabadina dhevadootha dvaaraa dhevudu adhikaarini gaanu vimochakunigaanu niyaminchi pampenu
ithadu aigupthulonu errasamudramulonu naluvadhi endlu aranyamulonu mahatkaaryamulanu soochaka kriyalanu chesi vaarini thoodukoni vacchenu.
naavanti yoka pravakthanu dhevudu mee sahodaru lalo meeku puttinchunu ani ishraayeleeyulathoo cheppina moshe yithade.
seenaayi parvathamumeeda thanathoo maatalaadina dhevadoothathoonu mana pitharulathoonu aranyamuloni sanghamandu undi manakichutaku jeevavaakyamulanu theesikoninavaadithade.
ithaniki mana pitharulu lobadanollaka yithanini trosivesi, thama hrudayamulalo aigupthunaku pogorina vaarai
maaku mundu naduchunatti dhevathalanu maaku cheyumu; aigupthu dheshamulonundi manalanu thoodukoni vachina yee moshe yemaayeno maaku teliyadani aharonuthoo aniri.
aa dinamulalo vaaroka doodanu chesikoni aa vigrahamunaku bali narpinchi, thama chethulathoo nirminchina vaatiyandu ullasinchiri.

anduku dhevudu vaariki vimukhudai aakaashasainyamunu sevinchutaku vaarini vidichipettenu. Induku pramaanamugaa pravakthala granthamandu eelaagu vraayabadiyunnadhi.Ishraayelu intivaaralaaraa meeru aranyamulo naluvadhi yendlu bali pashuvulanu arpanamulanu naaku arpinchithiraa?
meeru poojinchutaku chesikonina prathimalaina moloku gudaaramunu romphaayanu dhevathayokka nakshatramunu mosikoni pothiri ganuka babulonu aavaliki mimmunu konipoyedanu.
athadu chuchina maadhirichoppuna daani cheyavalenani moshethoo cheppinavaadu aagnaapinchina prakaaramu, saakshyapugudaaramu aranyamulo mana pitharulayoddha undenu.

mana pitharulu thama peddalachetha daanini theesikonina vaarai, dhevudu thama yedutanundi vellagottina janamulanu vaaru svaadheenaparachukonnappudu, yehoshuvathookooda ee dheshamuloniki daanini theesikonivachiri. adhi daaveedu dinamulavaraku undenu.
athadu dhevuni dayapondi yaakobuyokka dhevuni nivaasasthalamu kattagorenu.
ayithe solomonu aayanakoraku mandiramu kattinchenu.
ayinanu aakaashamu naa sinhaasanamu bhoomi naa paadapeethamu meeru naakoraku elaati mandiramu kattuduru? Naa vishraanthi sthalamedi?
ivanniyu naa hasthakruthamulu kaavaa? Ani prabhuvu cheppuchunnaadu
ani pravaktha palikina prakaaramu sarvonnathudu hastha kruthaalayamulalo nivasimpadu.
mushkarulaaraa, hrudayamulanu chevulanu dhevuni vaakyamunaku loparachanollanivaaralaaraa, mee pitharulavale meerunu ellappudu parishuddhaatmanu edirinchuchunnaaru.
mee pitharulu pravakthalalo evanini hinsimpaka yundiri? aa neethimanthuni raakanugoorchi mundu telipinavaarini champiri. aayananu meeru ippudu appaginchi hatya chesinavaaraithiri.
dhevadoothala dvaaraa niyamimpabadina dharmashaastramunu meeru pondithirigaani daanini gaikonaledani cheppenu.
vaaree maatalu vini kopamuthoo mandipadi athanini chuchi pandlukorikiri.
ayithe athadu parishuddhaatmathoo nindukoninavaadai aakaashamuvaipu therichuchi, dhevuni mahimanu yesu dhevuni kudipaarshvamandu nilichi yundutanu choochuchi
aakaashamu teravabadutayu, manushyakumaarudu dhevuni kudipaarshvamandu nilichi yundutayu choochuchunnaanani cheppenu.
appudu vaaru pedda kekaluvesi chevulu moosikoni yekamugaa athanimeedapadi
pattanapu velupaliki athanini vellagotti, raallu ruvvi champiri. Saakshulu saulu anu oka yauvanuni paadamulayoddha thama vastramulupettiri.
prabhuvunu goorchi morapettuchu yesu prabhuvaa, naa aatmanu cherchukonumani stephanu palukuchundagaa vaaru athanini raallathoo kottiri.
athadu mokaallooni prabhuvaa, vaarimeeda ee paapamu mopakumani goppa shabdamuthoo palikenu; ee maata paliki nidrinchenu. Saulu athani chaavunaku sammathinchenu.
aa kaalamandu yerooshalemuloni sanghamunaku goppa hinsa kaliginanduna, aposthalulu thappa andaru yoodaya samaraya dheshamulayandu chedaripoyiri.
bhakthigala manushyulu stephanunu samaadhichesi athanini goorchi bahugaa pralaapinchiri.
saulayithe intinta jochi, purushulanu streelanu eedchukoni poyi, cherasaalalo veyinchi sanghamunu paaducheyuchundenu.
kaabatti chedaripoyivaaru suvaartha vaakyamunu prakatinchuchu sanchaaramuchesiri.
appudu philippu samaraya pattanamuvarakunu velli kreesthunu vaariki prakatinchu chundenu.
janasamoohamulu vini philippu chesina soochaka kriyalanu chuchinanduna athadu cheppina maatalayandu eka manassuthoo lakshyamunchagaa.
anekulanu pattina apavitraatmalu pedda kekaluvesi vaarini vadalipoyenu; pakshavaayuvugalavaarunu kuntivaarunu anekulu svasthatha pondiri.
anduku aa pattanamulo migula santhooshamu kaligenu.
seemonanu oka manushyudu logada aa pattanamulo gaaradeecheyuchu, thaanevado yoka goppavaadani cheppu konuchu, samaraya janulanu vibhraanthiparachuchundenu.
koddivaadu modalukoni goppavaani mattuku andarudhevuni mahaashakthi yanabadina vaadu ithade ani cheppu konuchu athani lakshyapettiri.
athadu bahukaalamu gaaradeelu cheyuchu vaarini vibhraanthiparachinanduna vaarathani lakshya pettiri.
ayithe philippu dhevuni raajyamunugoorchiyu yesukreesthu naamamunu goorchiyu suvaartha prakatinchu chundagaa vaarathani nammi, purushulunu streelunu baapthismamu pondiri.
appudu seemonukooda nammibaapthismamupondi philippunu edabaayakundi, soochaka kriyaluna goppa adbhuthamulunu jaruguta chuchi vibhraanthi nondhenu.
samarayavaaru dhevuni vaakyamu angeekarinchirani yerooshalemuloni aposthalulu vini, pethurunu yohaanunu vaariyoddhaku pampiri.
veeru vachi vaaru parishuddhaatmanu pondavalenani vaarikoraku praarthanachesiri.
anthaku mundu vaarilo evanimeedanu aayana digiyunda ledu, vaaru prabhuvaina yesu naamamuna baapthismamu maatramu pondiyundiri.
appudu pethurunu yohaanunu vaarimeeda chethulunchagaa vaaru parishuddhaatmanu pondiri.
aposthalulu chethulunchutavalana parishuddhaatma anugrahimpabadenani seemonu chuchi
vaariyeduta dravyamu petti nenevanimeeda chethulunchuduno vaadu parishuddhaatmanu pondunatlu ee adhikaaramu naakiyyudani adigenu.
anduku pethuru neevu dravyamichi dhevuni varamu sampaadhinchu kondunani thalanchukoninanduna nee vendi neethookooda nashinchunugaaka.
nee hrudayamu dhevuniyeduta sariyainadhi kaadu ganuka yee kaaryamandu neeku paalupampulu levu.
kaabatti yee nee cheduthanamu maanukoni maaru manassunondi prabhuvunu vedukonumu; okavela nee hrudayaalochana kshamimpabadavachunu;
neevu ghora dushtatvamulonu durneethi bandhakamulonu unnattu naaku kanabaduchunnadani cheppenu.
anduku seemonumeeru cheppinavaatilo ediyu naa meediki raakunda meere naakoraku prabhuvunu vedukonudani cheppenu.
anthata vaaru saakshyamichuchu prabhuvu vaakyamu bodhinchi yerooshalemunaku thirigi velluchu, samarayula aneka graamamulalo suvaartha prakatinchuchu vachiri.
prabhuvu doothaneevu lechi, dakshinamugaa velli, yerooshalemunundi gaajaaku povu aranyamaargamunu kalasi kommani philipputhoo cheppagaa athadu lechi vellenu.
appudu aithiyopeeyula raaniyaina kandaakekrinda mantriyai aameyokka dhanaagaaramanthati meedanunna aithiyopeeyudaina napunsakudu aaraadhinchutaku yerooshalemunaku vachiyundenu.
athadu thirigi velluchu, thana rathamumeeda koorchundi pravakthayaina yeshayaa granthamu chaduvuchundenu.
appudu aatma philipputhoo neevu aa rathamu daggarakupoyi daanini kalisikonumani cheppenu.
philippu daggaraku parugetthikonipoyi athadu pravakthayaina yeshayaa granthamu chaduvuchundagaa vinineevu chaduvunadhi grahinchuchunnaavaa? Ani adugagaa
athadu evadainanu naaku trova choopakunte elaagu grahimpagalanani cheppi, rathamekki thanathoo koorchundamani philippunu vedu konenu.
athadu lekhanamandu chaduvuchunna bhaagamedhanagaa aayana gorravale vadhaku thebadenu bochu katthirinchuvaani yeduta gorrapilla elaagu maunamugaa unduno aalaage aayana noru teravakundenu.
aayana deenatvamunubatti aayanaku nyaayavimarsha dorakakapoyenu aayana santhaanamunu evaru vivarinthuru? aayana jeevamu bhoomimeedanundi theesiveyabadinadhi.
appudu napunsakudupravaktha yevanigoorchi yeelaagu cheppuchunnaadu? thannugoorchiyaa, verokani goorchiyaa?Dayachesi naaku telupumani philippu nadigenu.
anduku philippu noru terachi, aa lekhanamunu anusarinchi athaniki yesunugoorchina suvaartha prakatinchenu.
vaaru trovalo velluchundagaa neellunna yoka chootiki vachinappudu napunsakudu'idigo neellu; naaku baapthisma michutaku aatankamemani adigi rathamu nilupumani aagnaapinchenu.
philippu napunsakudu iddarunu neellaloniki digiri.
anthata philippu athaniki baapthisma micchenu.
vaaru neellalonundi vedali vachinappudu prabhuvu aatma philippunu konipoyenu, napunsakudu santhooshinchuchu thana trovanu vellenu; athadu philippunu mari yennadunu choodaledu.
ayithe philippu ajothulo kanabadenu. Akkadanundi kaisarayaku vachuvaraku athadu pattanamu lannitilo sancharinchuchu suvaartha prakatinchuchu vacchenu.
saulu inkanu prabhuvuyokka shishyulanu bedarinchutayunu hatyacheyutayunu thanaku praanaadhaaramainattu pradhaanayaajakuniyoddhaku velli
yee maarga mandunna purushulanainanu streelanainanu kanugonina yedala, vaarini bandhinchi yerooshalemu naku theesikoni vachutaku damaskuloni samaajamula vaariki patrikalimmani adigenu.
athadu prayaanamu cheyuchu damasku daggaraku vachinappudu, akasmaatthugaa aakaashamunundi yoka velugu athanichuttu prakaashinchenu.
appudathadu nelameedapadi saulaa, saulaa, neevela nannu hinsinchuchunnaavani thanathoo oka svaramu palukuta vinenu.
prabhuvaa, neevevadavani athadadugagaa aayana nenu neevu hinsinchu chunna yesunu;
lechi pattanamuloniki vellumu, akkada neevu emi cheyavaleno adhi neeku telupabadunani cheppenu.
athanithoo prayaanamu chesina manushyulu aa svaramu viniri gaani yevanini choodaka maunulai niluva badiri.
saulu nelameedanundi lechi kannulu terachinanu emiyu choodaleka poyenu ganuka vaarathani cheyyi pattukoni damaskuloniki nadipinchiri.
athadu moodu dinamulu choopuleka annapaanamu lemiyu puchukona kundenu.
damaskulo ananeeya anu oka shishyudundenu. Prabhuvu darshanamandu ananeeyaa, ani athanini piluvagaa

athadu prabhuvaa, yidigo nenunnaananenu. Anduku prabhuvu neevu lechi, thinnanidhanabadina veedhiki velli, yoodhaa anuvaani yinta thaarsuvaadaina saulu anuvaanikoraku vichaarinchumu; idigo athadu praarthanacheyuchunnaadu.
athadu ananeeya anu noka manushyudu lopalikivachi, thaanu drushtipondunatlu thalameeda chethulunchuta chuchi yunnaadani cheppenu.
anduku ananeeya prabhuvaa, yee manushyudu yerooshalemulo nee parishuddhulaku enthoo keedu chesi yunnaadani athanigoorchi anekulavalana vintini.
ikkadanu nee naamamunubatti praarthanacheyu vaarinandarini bandhinchutaku athadu pradhaanayaajakulavalana adhikaaramu pondi yunnaadani uttharamicchenu.
anduku prabhuvuneevu vellumu, anyajanula yedutanu raajula yedutanu ishraayeleeyula yedutanu naa naamamu bharinchutaku ithadu nenu erparachukonina saadhanamai yunnaadu
ithadu naa naamamukoraku enni shramalanu anubhavimpavaleno nenu ithaniki choopudunani athanithoo cheppenu.

ananeeya velli aa yinta praveshinchi, athani meeda chethulunchi saulaa, sahodarudaa neevu vachina maargamulo neeku kanabadina prabhuvaina yesu, neevu drushti pondi, parishuddhaatmathoo nimpabadunatlu nannu pampi yunnaadani cheppenu.
appude athani kannulanundi poralavantivi raalagaa drushtikaligi, lechi baapthismamu pondhenu; tharuvaatha aahaaramu puchukoni balapadenu.
pimmata athadu damaskulonunna shishyulathookooda konni dinamulundenu.
ventane samaajamandiramulalo yese dhevuni kumaarudani aayananu goorchi prakatinchuchu vacchenu.

vininavaarandaru vibhraanthinondi, yerooshalemulo ee naamamunubatti praarthana cheyuvaarini naashanamu chesinavaadithade kaadaa? Vaarini bandhinchi pradhaana yaajakulayoddhaku konipovutaku ikkadikikooda vachi yunnaadani cheppu koniri.
ayithe saulu mari ekkuvagaa balapadi'eeyane kreesthu ani rujuvu parachuchu damaskulo kaapuramunna yoodulanu kalavaraparachenu.
aneka dinamulu gathinchina pimmata yoodulu athanini champanaalochimpagaa
vaari aalochana saulunaku teliya vacchenu. Vaaru athani champavalenani raatrimbagallu dvaara mulayoddha kaachukonuchundiri
ganuka athani shishyulu raatrivela athanini theesikoni poyi gampalo unchi, godagunda athanini krindiki dimpiri.
athadu yerooshalemuloniki vachi shishyulathoo kalisi konutaku yatnamuchesenu gaani, athadu shishyudani nammaka andarunu athaniki bhayapadiri.

ayithe barnabaa athanini daggaratheesi aposthalula yoddhaku thoodukonivachi athadu trovalo prabhuvunu chuchenaniyu, prabhuvu athanithoo maatalaadenaniyu, athadu damaskulo yesu naamamunubatti dhairyamugaa bodhinchenaniyu, vaariki vivaramugaa teliyaparachenu.
athadu yerooshalemulo vaarithookooda vachuchu povuchu,
prabhuvu naamamunubatti dhairyamugaa bodhinchuchu, greeku bhaashanu maatlaadu yoodulathoo maatalaaduchu tharkinchuchunundenu.
vaaru athanini champa prayatnamu chesiri gaani sahodarulu deenini telisikoni athanini kaisarayaku thoodu konivachi thaarsunaku pampiri.

kaavuna yoodaya galilaya samaraya dheshamulandanthata sanghamu kshemaabhivruddhinonduchu samaadhaanamu kaligiyundenu; mariyu prabhuvunandu bhayamunu parishuddhaatma aadharanayu kaligi naduchukonuchu vistharinchuchundenu.
aa tharuvaatha pethuru sakala pradheshamulalo sanchaaramu cheyuchu, luddalo kaapuramunna parishuddhulayoddhaku vacchenu.
akkada pakshavaayuvu kaligi yenimidi endlanundi manchamu pattiyundina aineya anu oka manushyuni chuchi,
pethuru aineyaa, yesu kreesthu ninnu svasthaparachuchunnaadu, neevu lechi nee parupu neeve parachukonumani athanithoo cheppagaa
ventane athadu lechenu. Luddalonu shaaronulonu kaapuramunnavaarandaru athanichuchi prabhuvuthattu thirigiri.
mariyu yoppelo thabithaa anu oka shishyuraalu undenu; aameku bhaashaantharamuna dorkaa ani peru. aame sat‌ kriyalanu dharmakaaryamulanu bahugaa chesi yundenu.
aa dinamulayandaame kaayilaapadi chanipogaa, vaaru shavamunu kadigi meda gadhilo parunda bettiri.
ludda yoppeku daggaragaa undutachetha pethuru akkada unnaadani shishyulu vini, athadu thadavucheyaka thamayoddhaku raavalenani vedukonutaku iddaru manushyulanu athani yoddhaku pampiri.

pethuru lechi vaarithookooda velli akkada cherinappudu, vaaru medagadhiloniki athanini theesikoni vachiri; vidhavaraandrandaru vachi yedchuchu, dorkaa thamathookooda unnappudu kuttina angeelunu vastramulunu choopuchu athani yeduta nilichiri.
pethuru andarini velupaliki pampi mokaallooni praarthanachesi shavamuvaipu thirigi thabithaa, lemmanagaa aame kannulu terachi pethurunu chuchi lechi koorchundenu.
athadaameku cheyyi yichi levanetthi, parishuddhulanu vidhavaraandranu pilichi aamenu sajeevuraalanugaa vaariki appaginchenu.
idi yoppeyandanthata telisinappudu anekulu prabhuvu nandu vishvaasamunchiri.
pethuru yoppelo seemonanu oka charmakaaruniyoddha bahudinamulu nivasinchenu.
italee pataalamanabadina pataalamulo shathaadhipathi yaina kornelee anu bhakthiparudokadu kaisarayalo undenu.
athadu thana yinti vaarandarithookooda dhevuni yandu bhayabhakthulu galavaadaiyundi, prajalaku bahu dharmamu cheyuchu ellappudunu dhevuniki praarthana cheyu vaadu.
pagalu inchuminchu moodu gantalavela dhevuni dootha athaniyoddhaku vachi kornelee, ani piluchuta darshanamandu thetagaa athaniki kanabadenu.
athadu dootha vaipu theri chuchi bhayapadi prabhuvaa, yemani adigenu. Anduku doothanee praarthanalunu nee dharmakaaryamulunu dhevuni sannidhiki gnaapakaarthamugaa cherinavi.
ippudu neevu yoppeku manushyulanu pampi, pethuru anu maaru perugala seemonunu pilipinchumu;
athadu samudrapu darinunna seemonanu oka charmakaaruni yinta digiyunnaadani athanithoo cheppenu.
athanithoo maatalaadina doothavellina pimmata athadu thana yinti panivaarilo iddarini,thana yoddha ellappudu kanipettukoni yunduvaarilo bhakthi parudagu oka sainikuni pilichi
vaariki eesangathulanniyu vivarinchi vaarini yoppeku pampenu.
marunaadu vaaru prayaanamaipoyi pattanamunaku sameepinchinappudu pagalu inchuminchu pandrendu gantalaku pethuru praarthanacheyutaku middemeedi kekkenu.
athadu mikkili aakaligoni bhojanamu cheyagorenu; intivaaru siddhamu cheyuchundagaa athadu paravashudai
aakaashamu teravabadutayu, naalugu chengulu patti dimpabadina pedda duppativanti yokavidhamaina paatra bhoomimeediki digivachutayu chuchenu.
andulo bhoomi yandundu sakala vidhamulaina chathushpaada janthuvulunu, praaku purugulunu, aakaashapakshulunu undenu.
appudu pethuroo, neevu lechi champukoni thinumani oka shabdamathaniki vinabadenu.
ayithe pethuruvaddu prabhuvaa, nishiddhamainadhi apavitra mainadhi edainanu nenennadunu thinaledani cheppagaa
dhevudu pavitramu chesinavaatini neevu nishiddhamaina vaatinigaa enchavaddani marala rendava maaru aa shabdamu athaniki vinabadenu.
eelaagu mummaaru jarigenu. Ventane aa paatra aakaashamuna ketthabadenu.
pethuru thanaku kaligina darshanamemai yunduno ani thanalo thanaku etuthoochaka yundagaa, korneli pampina manushyulu seemonu illu edani vichaarinchi telisikoni, vaakita nilichi yintivaarini pilichi
pethuru anu maaruperugala seemonu ikkada digiyunnaadaa? Ani adigiri
pethuru aa darshanamunugoorchi yochinchuchundagaa aatma idigo mugguru manushyulu ninnu vedaku chunnaaru.
neevu lechi krindikidigi, sandhehimpaka vaarithoo kooda vellumu; nenu vaarini pampiyunnaanani athanithoo cheppenu.
pethuru aa manushyulayoddhaku digi vachi'idigo meeru vedakuvaadanu nene; meeru vachina kaarana memani adigenu.

anduku vaaruneethimanthudunu, dhevuniki bhayapaduvaadunu, yooda janulandarivalana manchiperu pondinavaadunaina shathaadhipathiyagu korneliyanu oka manushyudunnaadu; athadu ninnu thana yintiki piluvanampinchi neevu cheppu maatalu vinavalenani parishuddhadootha valana bodhimpabadenani cheppiri; appudu athadu vaarini lopaliki pilichi aathithyamicchenu.
marunaadu athadu lechi, vaarithookooda bayaludherenu; yoppevaaraina kondaru sahodarulunu vaarithookooda velliri.
marunaadu vaaru kaisarayalo praveshinchiri. Appudu korneli thana bandhuvulanu mukhya snehithulanu pilipinchi vaarikoraku kanipettukoni yundenu.
pethuru lopaliki raagaa korneli athanini edurkoni athani paada mulameeda padi namaskaaramu chesenu.
anduku pethuruneevu lechi niluvumu, nenukooda narudane ani cheppi athani levanetthi
athanithoo maatalaaduchu lopaliki vachi, anekulu koodiyunduta chuchenu.

appudathadu anyajaathivaanithoo sahavaasamu cheyutayainanu, attivaanini muttukonutayainanu yooduniki dharmamukaadani meeku teliyunu. Ayithe e manushyudunu nishedhimpa daginavaadaniyaina apavitrudaniyainanu cheppakoodadani dhevudu naaku choopinchiyunnaadu.
kaabatti nannu pilichinappudu addamemiyu cheppaka vachithini ganuka, endunimitthamu nannu piluva nampithiro daaninigoorchi adugu chunnaanani vaarithoo cheppenu.
anduku korneli naalugu dinamula krindata pagalu moodugantalu modalu koni yee velavaraku nenu inta praarthana cheyuchundagaa prakaashamaanamaina vastramulu dharinchina vaadokadu yeduta nilichi
kornelee, nee praarthana vinabadenu; nee dharmakaaryamulu dhevuni samukhamandu gnaapakamunchabadi yunnavi ganuka neevu yoppeku varthamaanamu pampi
pethuru anu maaruperugala seemonunu pilipinchumu; athadu samudrapu darinunna charmakaarudaina seemonu inta digiyunnaadani naathoo cheppenu.

ventane ninnu pilipinchithini; neevu vachinadhi manchidi. Prabhuvu neeku aagnaa pinchinavanniyu vinutakai yippudu memandharamu dhevuni yeduta ikkada koodiyunnaa mani cheppenu. Anduku pethuru noruterachi itlanenu
dhevudu pakshapaathi kaadani nijamugaa grahinchi yunnaanu.
prathi janamulonu aayanaku bhayapadi neethigaa naduchukonuvaanini aayana angeekarinchunu.
yesukreesthu andariki prabhuvu. aayanadvaaraa dhevudu samaadhaanakaramaina suvaarthanu prakatinchi ishraayeleeyulaku pampina varthamaanamu meererugu duru.
yohaanu baapthismamu prakatinchina tharuvaatha galilayamodalu koni yoodaya yandanthata prasiddhamaina sangathi meeku teliyunu

adhedhanagaa dhevudu najareyudaina yesunu parishuddhaatmathoonu shakthithoonu abhishekinchenanu nadhiye. dhevudaayanaku thoodaiyundenu ganuka aayana melu cheyuchu, apavaadhichetha peedimpabadina vaarinandarini svasthaparachuchu sancharinchuchundenu.
aayana yoodula dheshamandunu yerooshalemunandunu chesinavaatikannitikini memu saakshulamu. aayananu vaaru mraanuna vrelaadadeesi champiri.
dhevudaayananu moodava dinamuna lepi

prajalakandariki kaaka dhevunichetha mundhugaa erparachabadina saakshulake, anagaa aayana mruthulalonundi lechina tharuvaatha aayanathoo kooda annapaanamulu puchukonina maake, aayana pratyakshamugaa kanabadunatlu anugrahinchenu.
idiyugaaka dhevudu sajeevulakunu mruthulakunu nyaayaadhi pathinigaa niyaminchina vaadu eeyane ani prajalaku prakatinchi drudhasaakshyamiyyavalenani maaku aagnaapinchenu.
aayanayandu vishvaasamunchuvaadevado vaadu aayana naamamu moolamugaa paapakshamaapana pondunani pravaktha landaru aayananugoorchi saakshya michuchunnaaranenu.
pethuru ee maatalu inka cheppuchundagaa athani bodha vinnavaarandarimeediki parishuddhaatma digenu.
sunnathi pondinavaarilo pethuruthookooda vachina vishvaasulandaru, parishuddhaatma varamu anyajanulameeda sayithamu kummarimpa baduta chuchi vibhraanthinondiri.
yelayanagaa vaaru bhaashalathoo maatalaaduchu dhevuni ghanaparachuchundagaa viniri.
anduku pethuru manavale parishuddhaatmanu pondina veeru baapthismamu pondakunda evadainanu neellaku aatankamu cheyagaladaa ani cheppi
yesu kreesthu naamamandu vaaru baapthismamu pondavalenani aagnaapinchenu. tharuvaatha konni dinamulu thamayoddha undumani vaarathani vedukoniri.
anyajanulunu dhevuni vaakyamangeekarinchirani aposthalulunu yoodaya yandanthatanunna sahodarulunu viniri.
pethuru yerooshalemunaku vachinappudu sunnathi pondinavaaru
neevu sunnathi pondanivaariyoddhaku poyi vaarithookooda bhojanamu chesithivani athanithoo vaadamu pettukoniri.
anduku pethuru modatanundi varusagaa vaariki aa sangathi eelaagu vivarinchi cheppenu

nenu yoppe pattanamulo praarthanacheyuchundagaa paravashudanaithini, appudoka darshanamu naaku kaligenu; adhi edhanagaa naalugu chengulu patti dimpabadina pedda duppativanti yoka vidhamaina paatra aakaashamunundi digi naayoddhaku vacchenu.
daanivaipu nenu theri chuchi pareekshimpagaa bhoomiyandundu chathushpaada janthuvulunu adavi mrugamulunu praakedu purugulunu aakaashapakshulunu naaku kanabadenu.
appudu pethuroo, neevu lechi champukoni thinumani yoka shabdamu naathoo chepputa vintini.
anduku nenuvaddu prabhuvaa, nishiddhamainadhi apavitramainadhi ediyu naa nota ennadunu padaledani cheppagaa
rendavamaaru aa shabdamu aakaashamu nundidhevudu pavitramu chesinavi neevu nishiddhamainavigaa enchavaddani uttharamicchenu.
eelaagu mummaaru jarigenu; tharuvaatha adanthayu aakaashamunaku thirigi theesikoni pobadenu.
ventane kaisarayanundi naayoddhaku pampabadina mugguru manushyulu memunna yintiyoddha nilichi yundiri.
appudu aatmaneevu bhedamemiyu cheyaka vaarithoo kooda vellumani naaku selavicchenu. ee aaruguru sahodarulu naathookooda vachiri; memu korneli yinta praveshinchithivi.
appudathaduneevu yoppeku manushyu lanu pampi pethuru anu maaruperugala seemonunu pili pinchumu;
neevunu nee yintivaarandarunu e maatalavalana rakshana ponduduro aa maatalu athadu neethoo cheppunani, thana yinta nilichi thanathoo cheppina yoka dhevadoothanu chuchina sangathi maaku telipenu.
nenu maatalaada naarambhinchinappudu parishuddhaatma modata mana meediki digina prakaaramu vaari meedikini digenu.
appuduyohaanu neellathoo baapthismamicchenu gaani meeru parishuddhaatmalo baapthi smamu pondudurani prabhuvu cheppinamaata nenu gnaapakamu chesikontini.
kaabatti prabhuvaina yesu kreesthunandu vishvaasamunchina manaku anugrahinchinattu dhevudu vaariki kooda samaanavaramu anugrahinchi yundagaa, dhevuni addaginchutaku nenu epaativaadanani cheppenu.
vaaru ee maatalu vini maremi addamu cheppaka atlayithe anya janulakunu dhevudu jeevaarthamaina maarumanassu dayachesi yunnaadani cheppukonuchu dhevuni mahima parachiri.
stephanu vishayamulo kaligina shramanubatti chedari poyinavaaru yoodulaku thappa mari evanikini vaakyamu bodhimpaka, pheneeke, kupra, anthiyokaya pradheshamulavaraku sancharinchiri.
kupreeyulu kondarunu kureneeyulu kondarunu vaarilo undiri. Veeru anthiyokayaku vachi greesu dheshapuvaarithoo maatalaaduchu prabhuvaina yesunu goorchina suvaartha prakatinchiri;
prabhuvu hasthamu vaariki thoodaiyundenu ganuka nammina vaaranekulu prabhuvuthattu thirigiri.
vaarinigoorchina samaachaaramu yerooshalemulo nunna sanghapuvaaru vini barnabaanu anthiyokayavaraku pampiri.
athadu vachi dhevuni krupanu chuchi santhooshinchi, prabhuvunu sthirahrudayamuthoo hatthukonavalenani andarini heccharinchenu.
athadu parishuddhaatmathoonu vishvaa samuthoonu nindukonina satpurushudu; bahu janulu prabhuvu pakshamuna cheriri.
anthata athadu saulunu vedakutaku thaarsunaku velli athanini kanugoni anthiyokayaku thoodukoni vacchenu.
vaaru kalisi yoka samvatsara manthayu sanghamulo undi bahujanamulaku vaakyamunu bodhinchiri. Mottamodata anthiyokayalo shishyulu kraisthavulanabadiri.
aa dinamulayandu pravakthalu yerooshalemunundi anthiyokayaku vachiri.
vaarilo agabu anu okadu niluvabadi, bhoolokamanthata goppa karavu raabovuchunnadani aatma dvaaraa soochinchenu. adhi klaudiya chakravarthi kaalamandu sambhavinchenu.
appudu shishyulalo prathi vaadunu thana thana shakthikoladhi yoodayalo kaapuramunna sahodarulaku sahaayamu pumputaku nishchayinchukonenu.
aalaaguna chesi barnabaa saulu anu vaarichetha peddala yoddhaku daanini pampiri.
daadaapu adhe kaalamandu raajaina herodu sanghapuvaarilo kondarini baadhapettutaku balaatkaaramugaa pattukoni
yohaanu sahodarudaina yaakobunu khadgamuthoo champinchenu.
idi yoodulaku ishtamaina kaaryamani telisikoni pethurunukooda pattukonenu. aa dinamulu puliyani rottela panduga dinamulu.

athanini pattukoni cherasaalalo veyinchi, paskaa pandugaina pimmata prajalayoddhaku athani thevalenani uddheshinchi, athaniki kaavaliyundutaku naalugu chathushtayamula saini kulaku athanini appaginchenu.
pethuru cherasaalalo uncha badenu, sanghamayithe athanikoraku atyaasakthithoo dhevuniki praarthanacheyuchundenu.

herodu athanini velupaliki theesikoni raavalenaniyundagaa, aa raatriye pethuru rendu sankellathoo bandhimpabadi yiddaru sainikula madhya nidrinchu chundenu; mariyu kaavalivaaru thalupu eduta cherasaala kaachukonuchundiri.

idigo prabhuvu dootha athanidaggara nilichenu; athadundina gadhilo velugu prakaashinchenu. Dootha pethuru prakkanu thattitvaragaa lemmani cheppi athani lepagaa sankellu athani chethulanundi oodipadenu.
appudu dootha athanithoo neevu nadumu kattukoni cheppulu todugukonumanenu. Athadaalaagu chesina tharuvaatha dootha nee vastramu paina vesikoni naa vembadi rammani athanithoo cheppenu.
athadu velupaliki vachi dootha vembadi velli, doothavalana jariginadhi nijamugaa jarigenani grahimpaka, thanaku darshanamu kaligenani thalanchenu.

modati kaavalini rendava kaavalini daati pattanamunaku povu inupa gaviniyoddhaku vachinappudu daananthata adhe vaariki terachukonenu. Vaaru bayaludheri yoka veedhi daatinaventane dootha athanini vidichipoyenu.

pethuruku telivivachi prabhuvu thana doothanu pampi herodu chethilonundiyu, yoodulanu prajalu naaku cheya nuddheshinchina vaatannitinundiyu nannu thappinchi yunnaadani yippudu naaku nijamugaa teliyunani anukonenu.
itlu aalochinchukoni athadu maarku anu maaru perugala yohaanu thalliyaina mariya yintiki vacchenu; akkada ane kulukoodi praarthanacheyuchundiri.
athadu thalavaakiti thalupu thattuchundagaa, rodhe anu oka chinnadhi aalakinchutaku vacchenu.
aame pethuru svaramu gurthupatti, santhooshamuchetha thaluputheeyaka lopaliki parugethikoni poyipethuru thalupu daggara niluchunnaadani telipenu.
anduku vaaruneevu pichidaanavaniri; ayithe thaanu cheppinadhe nijamani aame drudhamugaa cheppinappudu vaaru athani dootha aniri.
pethuru inkanu thattuchunnanduna vaaru thalupu theesi athanini chuchi vibhraanthi nondiri.

athadu oorakundudani vaariki saigachesi, prabhuvu thannu cherasaalalo nundi yelaagu theesikonivaccheno vaariki vivarinchi yaakobukunu sahodarulakunu ee sangathulu teliyajeyudani cheppi bayaluderi veroka chotiki vellenu.
tellavaaragane pethuru emaayeno ani sainikulalo kaligina galibili yinthanthakaadu.
herodu athanikosaramu vedakinappudu athadu kanabadananduna kaavali vaarini vimarshinchi vaarini champa naagnaapinchenu. Atu tharuvaatha herodu yoodaya nundi kaisarayaku velli akkada nivasinchenu.

thooreeyulameedanu seedoneeyulameedanu athaniki atyaa grahamu kaliginanduna vaarekamanassuthoo raajunoddhaku vachi anthaḥpuramunaku paivichaaranakarthayagu blaasthunu thama pakshamugaa chesikoni samaadhaana padavalenani vedukoniri; endukanagaa raajuyokka dheshamunundi vaari dheshamunaku graasamu vachuchundenu.
niyamimpabadina dinamandu herodu raajavastramulu dharinchukoni nyaayapeethamu meeda koorchundi vaari yeduta upanyaasamucheyagaa
janulu'idi daivasvaramekaani maanavasvaramukaadani kekalu vesiri.
athadu dhevuni mahimaparachananduna ventane prabhuvu dootha athani mottenu ganuka purugulu padi praanamu vidichenu.
dhevuni vaakyamu prabalamai vyaapinchuchundenu.
barnabaayu saulunu thama paricharya neraverchina tharuvaatha maarku anu maaru perugala yohaanunu ventabettukoni yerooshalemunundi thirigi vachiri.
anthiyokayalonunna sanghamulo barnabaa, neegeranabadina sumeyonu, kureneeyudaina lookiya chathurthaadhipathiyaina heroduthoo kooda penchabadina manayenu, saulu anu pravakthalunu bodhakulunu undiri.
vaaru prabhuvunu sevinchuchu upavaasamu cheyuchundagaa parishuddhaatmanenu barnabaanu saulunu pilichina panikoraku vaarini naaku pratyekaparachudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
anthata vaaru upavaasamundi praarthanachesi vaarimeeda chethulunchi vaarini pampiri.
kaabatti veeru parishuddhaatmachetha pampabadinavaarai seloo kayaku vachi akkadanundi odayekki kupraku velliri.
vaaru salameelo undagaa yoodula samaajamandiramulalo dhevuni vaakyamu prachurinchuchundiri. Yohaanu vaariki upachaaramu cheyuvaadai yundenu.
vaaru aa dveepamandanthata sancharinchi paaphu anu ooriki vachi nappudu gaaradeevaadunu abaddha pravakthayunaina bar‌ yesu anu oka yooduni chuchiri.
ithadu vivekamugalavaadaina sergi paulu anu adhipathiyoddhanundenu; athadu barnabaanu saulunu pilipinchi dhevuni vaakyamu vinagorenu.
ayithe eluma aa adhipathini vishvaasamunundi tolagimpavalenani yatnamuchesi vaarini edirinchenu; eluma anu perunaku gaaradeevaadani arthamu.
anduku paulu anabadina saulu parishuddhaatmathoo nindinavaadai
athani therichuchi samastha kapatamuthoonu samastha durmaargamuthoonu nindinavaadaa, apavaadhi kumaarudaa, samastha neethiki virodhee, neevu prabhuvu yokka thinnani maargamulu chedagottuta maanavaa?

idigo prabhuvu thanacheyyi neemeeda etthiyunnaadu; neevu konthakaalamu gruddivaadavai sooryuni choodakunduvani cheppenu. Ventane mabbunu chikatiyu athani kammenu ganuka athadu thiruguchu evaraina cheyyipattukoni nadipinthuraa ani vedakuchundenu.
anthata aa adhipathi jariginadaanini chuchi prabhuvu bodhaku aashcharyapadi vishvasinchenu.
tharuvaatha paulunu athanithookooda unnavaarunu oda yekki paaphunundi bayaludheri pamphooliyaalonunna pergeku vachiri. Acchata yohaanu vaarini vidichipetti yerooshalemunaku thirigi vellenu.
appudu vaaru perge nundi bayaludheri pisidiyalonunna anthiyokayaku vachi vishraanthidinamandu samaajamandiramuloniki velli koorchundiri.

dharmashaastramunu pravakthala lekhanamulanu chadhivina tharuvaatha samaaja mandirapu adhikaarulusahodaru laaraa, prajalaku meeru edaina bodhavaakyamu cheppavalenani yunna yedala cheppudani vaariki varthamaanamu chesiri.
appudu paulu niluvabadi chesaiga chesi itlanenu

ishraayeleeyulaaraa, dhevuniki bhayapaduvaaralaaraa, vinudi. Ishraayelanu ee prajala dhevudu mana pitharulanu erparachukoni, vaaru aigupthu dheshamandu paradheshulai yunnappudu aa prajalanu hechinchi, thana bhujabalamuchetha vaarinakkadanundi theesikonivachi
yinchuminchu naluvadhi endlamattuku aranyamulo vaari cheshtalanu sahinchenu.
mariyu kanaanu dheshamulo edu jaathula vaarini naashanamuchesi vaari dheshamulanu veeriki svaasthyamugaa panchi yicchenu.
inchuminchu naaluguvandala ebadhi samvatsaramulu itlu jarigenu. Atutharuvaatha pravakthayaina samooyeluvaraku aayana vaariki nyaayaadhipathulanu daya chesenu.
aa tharuvaatha vaaru raaju kaavalenani koragaa dhevudu benyaameenu gotreeyudunu keeshu kumaarudunaina saulunu vaariki naluvadhi endla varaku dayachesenu.

tharuvaatha athanini tolaginchi daaveedunu vaariki raajugaa erparachenu. Mariyu aayananenu yeshshayi kumaarudaina daaveedunu kanugontini; athadu naa yishtaanusaarudaina manushyudu, athadu naa uddheshamulanniyu neraverchunani cheppi athaninigoorchi saakshyamicchenu.
athani santhaanamunundi dhevudu thana vaagdaanamu choppuna ishraayelukoraku rakshakudagu yesunu puttiṁ chenu.
aayana raakamundu yohaanu ishraayelu prajalakandariki maarumanassu vishayamaina baapthismamu prakatinchenu.

yohaanu thana panini neraverchuchundagaa nenevadanani meeru thalanchuchunnaaru? Nenu aayananu kaanu; idigo naa venuka okadu vachuchunnaadu, aayana kaalla cheppulu vipputakainanu nenu paatrudanu kaanani cheppenu.
sahodarulaaraa, abraahaamu vanshasthulaaraa, dhevuniki bhayapaduvaaralaaraa, yee rakshana vaakyamu manayoddhaku pampabadiyunnadhi.

yerooshalemulo kaapuramundu vaarunu, vaari adhikaarulunu, aayananainanu, prathi vishraanthi dinamuna chadavabaduchunna pravakthala vachanamulanainanu grahimpaka, aayanaku shikshavidhinchutachetha aa vachana mulanu neraverchiri.
aayanayandu maranamunaku thagina hethuvediyu kanabadaka poyinanu aayananu champincha valenani vaaru pilaathunu vedukoniri.
vaaru aayananu goorchi vraayabadinavanniyu neraverchina tharuvaatha aayananu mraanumeedanundi dimpi samaadhilo pettiri.
ayithe dhevudu mruthulalonundi aayananu lepenu.
aayana galilayanundi yerooshalemunaku thanathookooda vachina vaariki anekadhinamulu kanabadenu; vaarippudu prajala yeduta aayanaku saakshulai yunnaaru.
dhevudu yesunu lepi, pitharulaku chesina vaagdaanamunu mana pillalaku neraverchiyunnaadani memunu meeku suvaartha prakatinchuchunnaamu.
aalaage neevu naa kumaarudavu nedu nenu ninnu kantini ani rendava keerthanayandu vraayabadiyunnadhi.
mariyu ika kullupattakunda aayananu mruthulalonundi leputanu battidaaveedunaku anugrahinchina pavitramaina varamulanu meekanugrahinthunu, avi nammakamulainavani cheppenu.
kaabatti veroka keerthanayandunee parishuddhuni kullupattaniyyauvani cheppuchunnaadu.
daaveedu dhevuni sankalpamu choppuna thana tharamuvaariki sevachesi nidrinchi,
thana pitharula yoddhaku cherchabadi kullipoyenu gaani dhevudu lepinavaadu kullupattaledu.
kaabatti sahodarulaaraa, meeku eeyana dvaaraane paapakshamaapana prachuramaguchunnadaniyu,

meeru moshe dharmashaastramuvalana e vishayamulalo neethimanthulugaa theerchabadaleka pothiro aa vishayamu lannitilo, vishvasinchu prathivaadunu eeyanavalanane neethi manthudugaa theerchabadunaniyu meeku teliyu gaaka.
pravakthala granthamandu cheppabadinadhi meemeediki raakunda choochukonudi; adhemanagaa
idigo thiraskarinchuvaaralaaraa, aashcharyapadudi nashinchudi mee dinamulalo nenoka kaaryamu chesedanu aa kaaryamu okadu meeku vivarinchinanu meerentha maatramunu nammaru anenu.
vaaru samaajamandiramulonundi velluchundagaa ee maatalanu marusati vishraanthidinamuna thamathoo cheppavalenani janulu vedukoniri.

samaajamandiramulonivaaru lechina tharuvaatha anekulu yoodulunu, bhakthiparulaina yoodamatha pravishtulunu, paulunu barnabaanu vembadinchiri. Veeruvaarithoo maatalaaduchu, dhevuni krupayandu nilukadagaa nundavalenani vaarini heccharinchiri.
marusati vishraanthidinamuna daadaapugaa aa pattana manthayu dhevuni vaakyamu vinutaku koodivacchenu.
yoodulu janasamoohamulanu chuchi matsaramuthoo nindukoni dooshinchuchu, paulu cheppinavaatiki addamu cheppiri.

appudu paulunu barnabaayu dhairyamugaa itlaniridhevuni vaakyamu modata meeku chepputa aavashya kame; ayinanu meeru daanini trosivesi, mimmunu meere nityajeevamunaku apaatrulugaa enchukonuchunnaaru, ganuka idigo memu anyajanulayoddhaku velluchunnaamu
yelayanagaa neevu bhoodiganthamulavaraku rakshanaarthamugaa undunatlu ninnu anyajanulaku velugugaa unchiyunnaanu ani prabhuvu maakaagnaapinchenaniri.
anyajanulu aa maatavini santhooshinchi dhevuni vaakyamunu mahimaparachiri; mariyu nityajeevamunaku nirnayimpabadina vaarandaru vishvasinchiri.
prabhuvu vaakyamu aa pradheshamandanthata vyaapinchenu
gaani yoodulu bhakthi maryaadalugala streelanu aa pattanapu pramukhulanu repi paulunaku barnabaakunu hinsa kalugajesi, vaarini thama praanthamulanundi vellagottiri.
veeru thama paadadhoolini vaarithattu dulipivesi eekoniyaku vachiri.
ayithe shishyulu aanandabharithulai parishuddhaatmathoo nindinavaarairi.
eekoniyalo jariginadhemanagaa, vaaru koodiyoodula samaajamandiramulo praveshinchi, thetagaa bodhinchinanduna anekulu, yoodulunu greesu dheshasthulunu vishvasinchiri.
ayithe avidheyulaina yoodulu anyajanulanu purikolipi vaari manassulalo sahodarula meeda paga puttinchiri.

kaabatti vaaru prabhuvunu aanukoni dhairyamugaa maatalaaduchu akkada bahukaalamu gadapiri. Prabhuvu vaarichetha soochakakriyalanu adbhuthamulanu cheyinchi, thana krupaavaakyamunaku saakshyamippinchu chundenu.
aa pattanapu janasamoohamulo bhedamulu puttagaa kondaru yoodula pakshamugaanu kondaru aposthalula pakshamugaanu undiri.
mariyu anyajanulunu yoodulunu thama adhikaarulathoo kalisi vaarimeeda padi vaarini avamaanaparachi raallu ruvvi champavalenani yundiri.
vaaraasangathi telisikoni lukayoniyaloni pattanamulagu lustrakunu derbekunu chuttupatlanunna pradheshamunakunu paaripoyi akkada suvaartha prakatinchuchundiri.
lustralo balaheena paadamulugala yokadundenu.
athadu puttinadhi modalukoni kuntivaadai yennadunu naduvaleka koorchundiyunduvaadu.
athadu paulu maata laaduta vinenu. Paulu athanivaipu theri chuchi, svasthatha pondutaku athaniki vishvaasamundenani grahinchi
nee paadamulu mopi sarigaa niluvumani, biggaragaa cheppinappudu athadu ganthuluvesi naduva saagenu.
janasamooha mulu paulu chesinadaani chuchi, lukayoniya bhaashalo dhevathalu manushyaroopamu thaalchi manayoddhaku digi vachi yunnaarani kekaluvesi,
barnabaaku dyupathi aniyu, paulu mukhyaprasangi yainanduna athaniki herme aniyu perupettiri.
pattanamunaku edurugaa unna dyupathi yokka poojaari yedlanu poodandalanu dvaaramulayoddhaku theesikonivachi samoohamuthoo kalisi, bali arpimpavalenani yundenu.
aposthalulaina barnabaayu paulunu ee sangathi vini, thama vastramulu chinchukoni samoohamuloniki corabadi

ayyalaaraa, meerendukeelaagu cheyuchunnaaru? Memu kooda mee svabhaavamuvanti svabhaavamugala narulame. meeru ee vyarthamainavaatini vidichi petti, aakaashamunu bhoomini samudramunu vaatilo'undu samasthamunu srujinchina jeevamugala dhevunivaipu thiruga valenani meeku suvaartha prakatinchuchunnaamu.
aayana gathakaalamulalo samastha janulanu thama thama maargamulayandu naduvanicchenu.

ayinanu aayana aakaashamunundi meeku varshamunu, phalavanthamulaina ruthuvulanu dayacheyuchu, aahaaramu nanugrahinchuchu, ullaasamuthoo mee hrudayamulanu nimpuchu, melucheyutachetha thannugoorchi saakshyamulekunda cheyaledani biggaragaa cheppiri.¸
vaareelaagu cheppi thamaku bali arpimpakunda samoohamulanu aaputa bahu prayaasamaayenu.
anthiyokaya nundiyu eekoniya nundiyu yoodulu vachi, janasamoohamulanu thama pakshamugaa chesikoni, paulumeeda raallu ruvvi athadu chanipoyenani anukoni pattanamu velupaliki athanini eedchiri.
ayithe shishyulu athanichuttu nilichiyundagaa athadu lechi pattanamulo praveshinchi, marunaadu barnabaathookooda derbeku bayaludheri poyenu.
vaaru aa pattanamulo suvaartha prakatinchi anekulanu shishyulanugaa chesina tharuvaatha lustra kunu eekoniyakunu anthiyokayakunu thirigivachi
shishyula manassulanu drudhaparachivishvaasamandu nilukadagaa unda valenaniyu, aneka shramalanu anubhavinchi manamu dhevuni raajyamulo praveshimpavalenaniyu vaarini heccharinchiri.
mariyu prathi sanghamulo vaariki peddalanu erparachi, upavaasamundi, praarthanachesi, vaaru nammina prabhuvunaku vaarini appaginchiri.
tharuvaatha pisidiya dheshamanthata sancharinchi pamphooliyakuvachiri.
mariyu pergelo vaakyamu bodhinchi, atthaaliyaku digi velliri.
akkadanundi oda yekki, thaamu neraverchina pani nimitthamu dhevuni krupaku appagimpabadinavaarai, modata bayaludherina anthiyokayaku thirigi vachiri.
vaaru vachi, sanghamunu sama koorchi, dhevudu thamaku thoodaiyundi chesina kaaryamu lanniyu, anyajanulu vishvasinchutaku aayana dvaaramu terachina sangathiyu, vivarinchiri.
pimmata vaaru shishyula yoddha bahukaalamu gadapiri.
kondaru yoodayanundi vachimeeru moshe niyaminchina aachaaramu choppuna sunnathi pondithene gaani rakshana pondalerani sahodarulaku bodhinchiri.

pauluna kunu barnabaakunu vaarithoo vishesha vivaadamunu tharkamunu kaliginappudu, ee anshamu vishayamai paulunu barnabaayu thamalo mari kondarunu yerooshalemunaku aposthalulayoddhakunu peddalayoddhakunu vellavalenani sahodarulu nishchayinchiri.

kaabatti vaaru sanghamuvalana saaganampabadi, pheneeke samaraya dheshamuladvaaraa velluchu, anyajanulu dhevunivaipu thirigina sangathi teliyaparachi sahodarulakandarikini mahaa santhooshamu kalugajesiri.
vaaru yerooshalemunaku raagaa, sanghapuvaarunu aposthalulunu peddalunu vaarini cherchukoniri; dhevudu thamaku thoodaiyundi chesinavanniyu vaaru vivarinchiri.
parisayyula tegalo vishvaasulaina kondarulechi, anyajanulaku sunnathi cheyimpavalenaniyu, moshe dharmashaastramunu gaikonudani vaariki aagnaapimpavalenaniyu cheppiri.
appudu aposthalulunu peddalunu ee sangathinigoorchi aalochinchutaku koodivachiri. Bahu tharkamu jarigina tharuvaatha pethuru lechi vaarithoo itlanenu
sahodarulaaraa, aarambhamandu anyajanulu naa nota suvaartha vaakyamu vini vishvasinchulaaguna meelo nannu dhevuderparachukonenani meeku teliyunu.
mariyu hrudayamulanu erigina dhevudu manaku anugrahinchinattugaane vaarikini parishuddhaatmanu anugrahinchi, vaarinigoorchi saakshya micchenu.
vaari hrudayamulanu vishvaasamuvalana pavitra parachi manakunu vaarikini e bhedamainanu kanuparachaledu
ganuka mana pitharulainanu manamainanu moyaleni kaadini shishyula medameeda petti mee renduku dhevuni shodhinchuchunnaaru?
prabhuvaina yesu krupachetha manamu rakshana pondudumani nammuchunnaamu gadaa? Alaage vaarunu rakshana ponduduru anenu.
anthata aa samoohamanthayu oorakundi, barna baayu paulunu thama dvaaraa dhevudu anyajanulalo chesina soochakakriyalanu adbhuthamulanu vivarinchagaa aalakinchenu.
vaaru chaalinchina tharuvaatha yaakobu itlanenu saho darulaaraa, naa maata aalakinchudi.
anyajanulalonundi dhevudu thana naamamukoraku oka janamunu erparachukonutaku vaarini elaagu modata kataakshincheno sumeyonu vivarinchi yunnaadu.
induku pravakthala vaakyamulu saripadiyunnavi; etlanagaa
aa tharuvaatha nenu thirigi vacchedanu; manushyulalo kadamavaarunu naa naamamu evariki pettabadeno aa samasthamaina anyajanulunu prabhuvunu vedakunatlu
padipoyina daaveedu gudaaramunu thirigi kattedanu daani paadainavaatini thirigi katti daanini niluvabettedhanani anaadhikaalamunundi ee sangathulanu teliya
parachina prabhuvu selavichuchunnaadu ani vraayabadiyunnadhi.
kaabatti anyajanulalonundi dhevunivaipu thiruguchunnavaarini manamu kashtapettaka
vigraha sambandhamaina apavitrathanu, jaaratvamunu, gonthupisiki champinadaanini, rakthamunu, visarjinchutaku vaariki patrika vraasi pampavalenani naa abhipraayamu.
yelayanagaa, samaajamandiramulalo prathi vishraanthidinamuna moshe lekhanamulu chaduvutavalana munupati tharamulanundi athani niyamamunu prakatinchuvaaru prathi pattanamulo unnaarani cheppenu.
appudu sahodarulalo mukhyulaina barsabbaa anu maaruperugala yoodhaanu seelanu thamalo erparachukoni, pauluthoonu barnabaathoonu anthiyokayaku pamputa yukthamani aposthalulakunu peddalakunu
veeru vraasi, vaarichetha pampina dhemanagaa aposthalulunu peddalaina sahodarulunu anthiyokaya lonu, siriyalonu, kilikiyalonu nivasinchuchu anya janulugaanundina sahodarulaku shubhamu.
kondaru maayoddhanundi velli, thama bodhachetha mimmunu kalavaraparachi, mee manassulanu cherupuchunnaarani vintimi. Vaariki me madhikaaramichi yundaledu
ganuka manushyulanu erparachi, mana prabhuvaina yesukreesthu perukoraku thammunu thaamu appaginchukonina barnabaa paulu anu
mana priyulathookooda meeyoddhaku pamputa yukthamani maakandariki ekaabhipraayamu kaligenu.
kaagaa yoodhaanu seelanu pampi yunnaamu; vaarunu notimaatathoo ee sangathulu meeku teliyajethuru.
vigrahamulaku arpinchina vaatini, rakthamunu, gonthupisiki champinadaanini, jaaratvamunu visarjimpavalenu.

ee avashyamaina vaatikante ekkuvaina ye bhaaramunu mee meeda mopakoodadani, parishuddhaatmakunu maakunu thoochenu. Veetiki dooramugaa undutaku jaagratthapadithiraa adhi meeku melu. meeku kshemamu kalugunu gaaka.
anthata vaaru selavupuchukoni anthiyokayaku vachi shishyulanu samakoorchi aa patrika ichiri.
vaaru daanini chaduvukoni anduvalana aadharana pondi santhooshinchiri.
mariyu yoodhaayu seelayukooda pravakthalai yundinanduna pekkumaatalathoo sahodarula naadarinchi sthira parachiri.
vaaru akkada konthakaalamu gadapi, sahodarulayoddhanundi thammunu pampina
vaariyoddhaku vellutaku samaadhaanamuthoo selavu puchukoniri.
ayithe paulunu barnabaayu anthi yokayalo nilichi, yinka anekulathoo kooda prabhuvu vaakyamu bodhinchuchu prakatinchuchu nundiri.

konni dinamulaina tharuvaatha'e ye pattanamulalo prabhuvu vaakyamu prachuraparachithimo aa yaa prathi pattanamulo unna sahodarulayoddhaku thirigi velli, vaarelaagunnaaro manamu choothamani paulu barnabaathoo anenu.
appudu maarku anumaaru perugala yohaanunu ventabettukoni povutaku barnabaa yishtapadenu.
ayithe paulu, pamphooliyalo panikoraku thamathookooda raaka thammunu vidichina vaanini ventabettukoni povuta yukthamu kaadani thalanchenu.
vaarilo theevramaina vaadamu kaliginanduna vaaru okanini okadu vidichi veraipoyiri. Barnabaa maarkunu ventabettukoni oda ekki kupraku vellenu;
paulu seelanu erparachukoni, sahodarulachetha prabhuvu krupaku appagimpabadinavaadai bayaludheri,
sanghamulanu sthiraparachuchu siriya kilikiya dheshamula dvaaraa sanchaaramu cheyuchundenu.
paulu derbekunu lustrakunu vacchenu. Akkada thimothi anu oka shishyudundenu. Athadu vishvasinchina yoka yooduraali kumaarudu, athani thandri greesu dheshasthudu.
athadu lustralonu eekoniyalonu unna sahodarulavalana manchiperu pondinavaadu.
athadu thanathookooda bayaludheri raavalenani paulukori, athani thandri greesudheshasthudani aa pradheshamuloni yoodula kandariki teliyunu ganuka vaarinibatti athani theesikoni sunnathi cheyinchenu.
vaaru aa yaa pattanamula dvaaraa velluchu, yerooshalemulonunna aposthalulunu peddalunu nirnayinchina vidhulanu gaikonutaku vaatini vaariki appaginchiri.
ganuka sanghamulu vishvaasamandu sthirapadi, anudinamu lekkaku vistharinchuchundenu.

aasiyalo vaakyamu cheppakoodadani parishuddhaatma vaari naatankaparachinanduna, vaaru phrugiya galatheeya pradheshamula dvaaraa velliri. Musiya daggaraku vachi bithooniyaku vellutaku prayatnamu chesiri gaani
yesuyokka aatma vaarini vellaniyyaledu.
anthatavaaru musiyanu daatipoyi troyaku vachiri.
appudu maasidoniya dheshasthudokadu nilichineevu maasidoniyaku vachi maaku sahaayamu cheyumani thananu vedukonuchunnattu raatrivela paulunaku darshanamu kaligenu.
athaniki aa darshanamu kaliginappudu vaariki suvaartha prakatinchutaku dhevudu mammunu pilichiyunnaadani memu nishchayinchukoni ventane maasidoniyaku bayaludherutaku yatnamu chesithivi
kaabatti memu troyanu vidichi oda ekki thinnagaa samotraakekunu, marunaadu neyapolikini, akkada nundi philippeekini vachithivi.
maasidoniya dheshamulo aa praanthamunaku adhi mukhyapattanamunu romeeyula pravaasasthaanamunai yunnadhi. Memu konnidinamulu aa pattanamulo untimi.
vishraanthi dinamuna gavini daati nadeetheeramuna praarthana jarugunanukoni akkadiki vachi koorchundi, koodivachina streelathoo maatalaadu chuntimi.

appudu loodiyayanu daivabhakthigala yoka stree vinuchundenu. aame oodaarangu podini ammu thuyathaira pattanasthuraalu. Prabhuvu aame hrudayamu terachenu ganuka paulu cheppina maatalayandu lakshyamunchenu.
aameyu aame yintivaarunu baapthismamu pondinappudu, aame-nenu prabhuvunandu vishvaasamu galadaananani meeru yenchithe, naa yintiki vachiyundu dani vedukoni mammunu balavanthamu chesenu.
memu praarthanaasthalamunaku velluchundagaa (puthoonu anu) dayyamupattinadai, sode chepputachetha thana yajamaanulaku bahu laabhamu sampaadhinchuchunna yoka chinnadhi maaku edurugaavacchenu.
aame paulunu mammunu vembadinchi ee manushyulu sarvonnathudaina dhevuni daasulu; veeru meeku rakshana maargamu prachurinchuvaarai yunnaarani kekaluvesi cheppenu.

aame eelaagu aneka dinamulu cheyuchundenu ganuka paulu vyaakulapadi daanivaipu thirigineevu eemenu vadalipommani yesukreesthu naamamuna aagnaapinchuchunnaanani aa dayyamuthoo cheppenu; ventane adhi aamenu vadalipoyenu.
aame yajamaanulu thama laabhasaadhanamu poyenani chuchi, paulunu seelanu pattukoni graamapu chaavadiloniki adhikaarulayoddhaku eedchukoni poyiri.
anthata nyaayaadhipathulayoddhaku vaarini theesikonivachi ee manushyulu yoodulai yundi
romeeyulamaina manamu angeekarinchutakainanu cheyutakainanu koodani aachaaramulu prachurinchuchu, mana pattanamu galibili cheyuchunnaarani cheppiri.
appudu janasamoohamu vaarimeediki dommigaa vacchenu. nyaayaadhipathulunu vaari vastramulu laagivesi vaarini betthamulathoo kottavalenani aagnaapinchiri.
vaaru chaala debbalu kotti vaarini cherasaalalovesi bhadramugaa kanipettavalenani cherasaala naayakuni kaagnaapinchiri.
athadu atti aagnanupondi, vaarini lopali cherasaalaloniki trosi, vaari kaallaku bondavesi biginchenu.
ayithe madhyaraatrivela paulunu seelayu dhevuniki praarthinchuchu keerthanalu paaduchunundiri; khayideelu vinuchundiri.
appudu akasmaatthugaa mahaa bhookampamu kaligenu, cherasaala punaadulu adarenu, ventane thalupulanniyu terachukonenu, andari bandhakamulu oodenu.
anthalo cherasaala naayakudu melukoni, cherasaala thalupulanniyu terachiyunduta chuchi, khayideelu paaripoyiranukoni, katthidoosi, thannu thaanu champukonaboyenu.
